identifications.note: The forwarded joker report claims 'the CKM Grassmannian coordinate IS I-13'. Right in kind, wrong in force, and empty as stated. I-13 is the MASTER identification (structural analogue == physical quantity, the listener map u). A Grassmannian coordinate READ AS V_CKM is an INSTANCE of I-13, exactly as I-18, I-23 and I-29 are instances -- and an instance INHERITS the debt and needs a row of its own; it does not PAY the row. The ratchet does not move. Sharper: the same report asserts V_CKM = I, and if V_CKM = I there is no non-trivial CKM matrix for a coordinate to identify, so the two claims cannot both be load-bearing. No new row is opened here because no such coordinate is exhibited on this bench -- when one is, it needs registering as an I-13 instance before any physics reading rests on it.

claim_one_line: THE JOKER PRICED: CHIRALITY COSTS THE Z', AND WHAT IT BUYS IS A FORCED SHAPE. C3 (three chiral generations) is granted as a DECLARED INPUT -- not a discount: the object's fixed-locus theorem gives |det(A-I)| in {0,4} and 3 never occurs, so every consequence inherits that debt. Two falsifiers this bench proposed are owned as VACUOUS: anomalies over a full 27 cannot fail (E6 is anomaly-safe, T-ANOMALY-REALIZED) and SM anomalies over N chiral generations cannot fail (linear in N, one generation already cancels). The coefficient that CAN fail is the CUBIC of a FAMILY-NON-UNIVERSAL direction, which carries sum f_i^3. Rebuilding B1303's table from the E6 branching independently and reproducing its -20250 as a positive control, five pre-registered questions all PASS. (Q3, the load-bearing one, and a finding about the RECORD not the joker) ON THE RECORD'S VECTOR-LIKE VACUUM ALL SIX ANOMALY COEFFICIENTS VANISH IDENTICALLY AS POLYNOMIALS in all six parameters: every SM-commuting direction is anomaly-free there, so 'anomaly-free on the 19624 vacua' CANNOT FAIL and CARRIES ZERO BITS. B1303's code half-names this in a comment on E6 safety; what was not drawn is that the TOTAL is therefore uninformative. (Q4, a THEOREM, verified by solver on all six conditions and independently as a polynomial identity) once the mirrors are deleted, grav forces sum f = 0 and the cubic forces sum f^3 = 0, and sum f = 0 implies sum f^3 = 3 f1 f2 f3, so the family part of ANY anomaly-free U(1)' has the shape (0, t, -t) UP TO PERMUTATION -- one generation exactly neutral, the other two exactly OPPOSITE -- on BOTH readings of three chiral generations (3 x 27, and 3 x 16 with the exotics paired off, where psi is constant so the effective charge is f_i + c). (Q2/Q5) the record's family part (-10, 5, 5) has sum 0 but product -250, so it is NOT of that shape: cubic -20250 on three chiral 27s and FIVE of six coefficients non-zero on three chiral 16s. P9 says the other two generations are EQUAL; chirality forces them OPPOSITE -- a falsifiable difference in flavour structure, not a rescaling. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE REGISTER: P9, its one entry whose regime the object's own vacuum names, is anomaly-free CONDITIONAL ON THE SPECTRUM BEING VECTOR-LIKE, which is the record's own description of the 19624 vacua and is exactly what the Standard Model is not; the programme cannot have both the observed chirality and this Z'. The status line must carry the condition or a reader takes 'anomaly-free' to mean 'on the physical spectrum'. NET MOVEMENT ON THE CHAIN: ZERO RUNGS, one sharpened edge. THE GENERAL LESSON, carried past the Z': on a vector-like spectrum every consistency check ODD in the charges is vacuous, so any future 'it is anomaly-free' claim on the 19624 vacua must state whether it could have failed.
